dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, Adrian. Rachel Tan speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or still travelling?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Rachel. I'm back in Singapore now, at my office. The regional trip was quite packed, so I'm glad to be sitting at my own desk again.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good, I'll keep this focused. Before we get into the call, could you provide your identification particulars for our usual verification?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My NRIC is S one one six three nine nine four E. My date of birth is 10 April 1967. I've got my paperwork beside me as well. The fund I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. Use euros as the currency for this transaction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Let me cover the points on my side first. Your objective is income and broader exposure through emerging-market debt, and you're prepared to hold through market fluctuations. That's the objective we're working towards. I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its emerging-market debt holdings support your income objective and spread your exposure across issuers and markets.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 250,000. I've set aside a quiet slot for this call. My staff know not to interrupt unless something urgent comes up.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: All right. The transaction fee is 0.5% of the amount invested. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your income objective?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to bear investment losses in pursuit of income. Set the quantity at 1,000 units. I want to buy, not dispose of my holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. You mentioned the trip was packed. Was it mostly visiting your existing wholesale customers, or catching up with your regional staff?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Mostly existing customers, with some staff meetings squeezed in. The meetings were fine, but moving between hotels and offices took up a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds tiring. For routine contact, would you still prefer us to telephone rather than arrange a visit to the branch?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, telephone is much easier for me. Even when I'm in Singapore, getting away from the office can turn a short appointment into half a day.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note your contact preference. If you're overseas, we can arrange a suitable calling window beforehand, rather than catching you between meetings or at the airport.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would help, thanks. I usually know my meeting schedule before I fly. Coming back to today's call, Place it as a limit order, with a limit price of 250 euros per unit.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your final instruction is to buy 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, for an amount of 250,000 euros, using a limit order with a limit price of 250 euros per unit. Please confirm that this is the instruction you want us to execute.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction. Please proceed as you've just stated. There's one other thing I should mention before we finish. Part of the subscription money is cash I collected for a business associate I'd rather not name. He asked me to route it through my personal account and keep the underlying source off the paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for telling me. I need to refer that disclosure to the appropriate review team. They'll advise on the information and documentation required.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Okay. Please contact me directly about any paperwork. My office staff handle my business diary, but I prefer to deal with bank correspondence myself.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Noted. I'll use your registered contact details for follow-up. Is there a convenient part of the day to reach you without interrupting your customer meetings?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Late afternoon is generally better. If I miss the call, leave a simple callback message and I'll return it when I'm free.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. I'll keep any voicemail brief. Thank you for your time today, Adrian. I'll be in touch regarding the administrative follow-up.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. That's fine. I'll keep an eye out for your call. Have a good afternoon.
